name: Uscreen
desc: All-in-one video monetization platform for creating, hosting, and selling online courses, memberships, and video content.

actions.name: create_user
actions.description: Creates a new user and optionally sends them a welcome email to your storefront.

actions.name: assign_user_access
actions.description: Assigns a bundle or subscription to a customer. Creates a new customer if one doesn't exist.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: paid_order
triggers.description: Triggers when a payment is processed for subscriptions, bundles, or content.

triggers.name: new_user
triggers.description: Triggers when a new user is added to your storefront.

triggers.name: began_to_play_video
triggers.description: Triggers when a user plays a video for the first time.

triggers.name: canceled_subscription
triggers.description: Triggers when a subscription is canceled for a user.

triggers.name: user_updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a user’s profile or information is updated.
